data.title: Fed Holds Interest Rates Steady Amid Inflation Concerns
data.description: The Federal Reserve maintained its benchmark interest rate at 5.25-5.50% during its latest meeting, citing persistent inflation above the 2% target.

data.title: NVIDIA Reports Record Q4 Revenue Driven by AI Chip Demand
data.description: NVIDIA posted $22.1 billion in quarterly revenue, a 265% year-over-year increase, driven by surging demand for its H100 and upcoming B200 AI accelerators.

data.title: Bitcoin Surpasses $70,000 as Institutional Adoption Grows
data.description: Bitcoin reached a new all-time high above $70,000, with analysts pointing to spot ETF inflows and growing institutional participation as key drivers.
